defects.detail: 'Et nõ b̃i q̃ infirm⁹ deponat se sup lectum extensus p tres horas' rendered 'do not allow the sick person to lie down on a bed ... for at least three hours', which contradicts the following 'sic iaceat p tres horas' (likely 'then it is well that he lie down'); follows the OCR 'nõ' literally
'ex illa lotione veniũt in sompno que venturi sunt' rendered 'those things which are to come in sleep will be revealed' — loose

reason: Eye remedies and silver seal-wax recipe rendered faithfully; one clause about lying down reads as a prohibition that contradicts the next step; otherwise = source.

defects.detail: 'Quo nomine aliquanto post ab Inquisitoribus ignominiâ notatus est' rendered 'For this name, he was marked with ignominy' — 'quo nomine' = 'on this account'

reason: Hemmingford testimonia and Arnold of Villanova entries (born 1300 at Villanova, Mariana's homunculus report, 'floruit ante annos 300') all = source; one idiom rendered literally.
Source is OCR garble (random syllable strings such as 'ཨཡ་ཨུ་གིས་ཨོ་ཡ'); the output correctly declines to translate and invents nothing.

defects.detail: note identifies 浮園 as 'the author Choe Hyang-won' and 庚子 as '1780'; neither is in the source
'浮雲樹色嘉陵心落日江聲襟韻未萬里虞先生舊' (corrupt/misordered couplet) rendered as confident prose 'do not quite reach the distant spirit of Master Yu'
'秋生庾園鷄歸少客到高樓蛺語多' split into 'The chickens return when few guests have arrived' / 'Many butterflies speak to the high tower' — mis-parses the parallel couplet (鷄歸少 / 客到 ... 語多)
'等恥杜瀾微亭難高岑未少處' rendered 'not at all inferior to Du Fu, Han Yu, Gao Shi, or Cen Shen' — 韓 is not in the source

reason: Opening argument on Korean vs Chinese poetics is faithful, but the quoted couplets at the end are mis-parsed and the garbled lines are papered over; notes assert a date and an author identity not in source.

reason: Sections VIII–X (demonic signs, Cush/Zoroaster, no white magic) = source, but the first paragraph (about a quarter of the page, the magic-vs-medicine argument) is dropped.
Closing formula, N.B. on the first/second points (black/red hangings), and third point setup with bread and wine all = source.
Diagram page with no text; output reproduces the image description faithfully.
Catalogue label (No. 1058-gha, Sūtikādhyāya, Varāhamihira, extent 11, jyotiṣa, complete) = source.
